parameters.name: DataSourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data source associated with the crawler. The data source must be bound to a DataWorks workspace, and the data source type must match the Type value.

parameters.name: EnableAiComment
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable AI metadata descriptions. This parameter is supported only when the SupportAiComment value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities is true.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the metadata crawler. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: Options
parameters.description: The extended configuration for the crawler type. The key names, value types, required fields, default values, and valid values are determined by the SupportedOptionKeys value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Serverless 2.0 resource group used to run the collection task. Whether this parameter is required depends on the RequireResourceGroup value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities.

parameters.name: ScheduleConfig
parameters.description: The scheduling configuration. If this parameter is not specified, manual scheduling is used.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: The collection scope configuration. If this parameter is not specified, the DefaultScopeUnit value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities is used.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The crawler type. Call GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities to query the valid values supported in the current region.
